overview_description.description: WANTD is the first sneaker marketplace built specifically for power resellers, who hold 80% of the secondary sneaker market supply.  These power sellers are looking for ways to bulk manage their inventory while preserving their brand identity online, helping them move inventory quickly and efficiently.  WANTD provides a platform for live video auctions, virtual storefronts, and bulk listing tools so that these resellers can move inventory in minutes, not weeks.
